findings.description: The Lambda environment includes an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. Lambda environment variables can be read by principals with appropriate Lambda configuration access and may be exposed through deployment artifacts, state, logs, or source control, enabling credential theft and reuse.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known vulnerabilities in the runtime or its managed execution environment may remain exploitable.
